lead: Adolf Hitler was a politician, born on 20 April 1889 in Braunau am Inn.
He died on 30 April 1945 in Führerbunker at the age of 56.
He is associated with work such as Mein Kampf and has held the office of Reich Chancellor and Reichsstatthalter.
The sections that follow break down Adolf Hitler's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Adolf Hitler — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Adolf Hitler was born on 20 April 1889 in Braunau am Inn, and holds citizenship of Cisleithania, Austria and German Reich.
Public records name his father, Alois Hitler and his mother, Klara Hitler. He is a sibling of Ida Hitler, Paula Hitler, Gustav Hitler, Edmund Hitler, Otto Hitler and Alois Hitler, Jr.
He studied at Lambach Abbey and Bundesrealgymnasium Linz Fadingerstraße.
He is recorded as speaking Austrian German and German.

sections.heading: Adolf Hitler — Career and Professional Work
paras: Adolf Hitler works primarily as a politician and Holocaust perpetrator.
Among the credits most often linked to Adolf are Mein Kampf.

He has held the following offices: Reich Chancellor (1933–1945), Reichsstatthalter (1933–1945), president of Germany (1934–1945), member of the Reichstag of the Weimar Republic and member of the Reichstag of Nazi Germany. He is affiliated with German Workers' Party.
He has taken part in Aktion T4, The Holocaust, Beer Hall Putsch and Munich agreement.

sections.heading: Adolf Hitler — Net Worth: What Is Actually Verifiable
paras: Net-worth figures for Adolf Hitler circulate widely online, but almost none of them come from an audited or officially published source. BioStar does not invent or repeat unsourced numbers, so no dollar figure is stated on this page.

What can be said from the public record is where his income is likely to originate: professional work as a politician and Holocaust perpetrator, project fees and royalties from credited work and public office remuneration.
If a verified figure is published by a credible outlet — a company filing, an election affidavit, or an official disclosure — this section will be updated with the source attached.
